text:
oncall-bot: SLO BURN ALERT: service=text-generation success_rate_slo=99.5% burn_rate=6.8 window=10m fallback_window=60m -> paging criteria met (:pager:). Please ack and triage. Details: https://monitoring.internal/redwood/alerts/98765

eliot: acked. I'm on it, starting quick checks on replicas and recent deploys.

rahul: looking at graphs. There's a spike of ~1200 rps and error ratio up to 2.4% on /v1/generate around 12:18 UTC. Not obvious deploy in last 24h.

sophia: taking lead for mitigation. @marta please stand by for handoff if this goes longer than 20m.

eliot: grep'd logs, seeing a surge of downstream timeouts to embeddings-cache in a few pods. snippet:
```
2025-11-03T12:18:21Z ERROR transport.go:142 timeout calling embeddings-cache: context deadline exceeded
```

rahul: could be transient cache eviction + sudden traffic. I'm going to temporarily add circuit breaker on calls to embeddings-cache (config name: `embed_cache_cb`) to fail fast and fall back to local LRU. Pushing patch to staging and will roll to prod if green.

sophia: good. If that doesn't drop burn, we'll scale the embeddings-cache pool.

jordan: customer-impact check: querying support-logs; 8 customers hit 5xx within last 15m but most are minor retries. No high-severity inbound tickets yet. I'm flagging a possible impact to a few PLG flows.

eliot: mitigation plan summary: 1) enable embed_cache_cb to fail-fast, 2) bump embeddings-cache pool by +2 nodes, 3) quiet non-actionable SLO pages if multi-window pattern suggests short blip.

sophia: executed step 1. Patch rolled to 3 pods: `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/text-gen EMBED_CB=enabled` -> logs show local fallback engaged, error ratio dropping on those pods.

rahul: scaling embeddings-cache via autoscaler (manual override): `gcloud compute --increase 2 --group embeddings-cache-prod` -> started.

oncall-bot: NOTE: paging silenced for this alert for teams with incident_role=observer to reduce noise while mitigation in progress.

eliot: quick telemetry: 10m burn dropped from 6.8 -> 2.1 in ~8 minutes after fallback, 1h window unaffected yet.

sophia: consensus: this is a transient infrastructure/backpressure pattern — not a code regression. Recommend we avoid immediate threshold change but add a guard in the paging policy: require both short-window (10m) AND medium-window (1h) burn above thresholds before page. That would block pages for short spikes like this.

marta: +1. We keep alerting for visibility but prevent noisy pages. Any objections?

jordan: agree. Also request a dashboard tile that shows side-by-side 10m/1h burn rates per service and a list of recent paging events. I'll sketch layout.

eliot: creating follow-up ticket: RW-INC-3217 - "SLO paging: require multi-window confirmation and blip suppression" assigning to eng-sre. Adding acceptance criteria:
- new paging rule implemented (10m AND 1h)
- backfill run to compute missed paging risk
- dashboard with 10m/1h and recent pages
- runbook update on when to override quieting

rahul: also propose a budget-reserve policy: allow small transient burn up to X tokens/min without paging (we'll quantify). That will be a config knob in `slo-policies` service.

sophia: for the short term, let's tweak the alert so one-off 10m spikes don't page. We can change paging criteria to: `page if (burn_10m > threshold AND burn_1h > threshold/2) OR (burn_10m > threshold_forced)` — basically require corroboration.

eliot: i'll update the alert rule in prod-alerts repo and run it through the canary workflow. Patch: `alerts/production/slo_burn_rules.yaml`
```
- name: text-gen-slo-burn
  expr: slo_burn_rate{service="text-gen"}
  page_if: (window=="10m" and value > 5) and (window=="1h" and value > 2.5)
```

marta: tiny caveat: ensure on-call override still pages for incidents with direct customer-reported outages. We'll include an annotation `force_page=true` on P1 incidents.

jordan: I've started the dashboard ticket RW-DASH-114: adds panel for slo_burn(10m/1h), recent pages, and worst offenders. cc @product-observability.

oncall-bot: Incident update: mitigation in progress, error ratio decreasing, paging suppressed per temporary policy.

eliot: handing off to @marta for watch window. I'll keep monitoring for another 30m and then join post-mortem if needed.

marta: acked, taking watch. I'll escalate if metrics deviate. Please add any notes to RW-INC-3217.

sophia: postmortem notes to capture: root cause hypothesis = cache saturation/backpressure; mitigation steps = fail-fast fallback + adding cache capacity; long-term actions = multi-window paging rule, budget-reserve config, dashboard, runbook updates.

rahul: also we should consider adding an automated check that prevents autoscaler from thrashing cache nodes during transient pressure; file it under infra improvements.

jordan: support update draft: "We observed transient errors affecting requests to text-generation. Mitigation deployed and service stabilized. No customer data lost. Follow-up timeline TBD." Will ping if any customers escalate.

marta: thanks all. Watch-only for now. If anyone needs to re-escalate, ping @pagerduty-bot.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved: metrics within normal ranges. Creating post-incident review reminder in 24h.

eliot: wrapping up: I'll open a PR for alert rule change + include a short backfill analysis to make sure we don't miss real incidents.

sophia: good. Nice quick mitigation and clear ops discussion.

marta: handing off final watch to @jordan at 13:00UTC. Good job team :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Hand-off recorded: from marta -> jordan at 2026-03-15T13:00:00Z.
